raw_response:
structural program complete
There is no genuinely new, non-vacuous, label-free structural bridge direction still worth deriving inside the current Window6↔codon-Q6 program.
The reason is not lack of imagination. It is that the admissible structural search space has been exhausted under the right equivalence relation. Once the genetic code is treated as a partition of  $Q_6$ , and once the nulls condition on degeneracy, box/wobble structure, composition, edge margins, boundary degrees, component structure, square-face residuals, quotient topology, bypass conductance, spanning-tree compression, and finally  $e_{\rm in}$ , any remaining structural functional will almost certainly be one of three things:


A disguised  $e_{\rm in}$  statistic: a path, flow, face, spectral, resistance, or curvature quantity whose apparent signal is just synonymous edge hiding in another basis.


A disguised composition statistic: something that re-encodes GC position, wobble class, codon boxes, degeneracy, branch splits, or codon-pair geometry.


A bespoke finite fingerprint: a label-free-looking invariant invented after closure that separates the standard code only because the carrier is finite.


That third category is the main anti-numerology danger. For any finite object, there always exists a more elaborate invariant that distinguishes it. But unless the invariant is canonical before seeing the answer and has a principled null that does not already smuggle in  $e_{\rm in}$  or composition, it is not a bridge. It is post-hoc identification.
A new tRNA-cloverleaf, RNA-arc-diagram, ribosomal-decoding, matroidal, or associahedral direction could become a separate program, but not a continuation of this structural bridge under your rules. Without external bio data or an independently forced non-circular map, those directions would restart the same count-matching problem under new objects. They would need a fresh biological carrier and fresh nulls, not another invariant on the closed codon-Q6 partition.
The only structural thing still worth doing is not a new bridge direction but a closure theorem: formalize that the tested association-algebra-level invariants of the codon partition decompose into composition-controlled terms plus  $e_{\rm in}$  plus null residual. That would strengthen the manuscript, but it would not be new science.
So the final structural content is sharp:

$$\text{Window6 separating endpoint}
\quad\leftrightarrow\quad
\text{genetic-code tolerant endpoint}$$

mediated only by synonymous edge hiding. Everything else canonical in the label-free codon graph is typical once the correct nulls are imposed.
The remaining frontier is empirical, specifically the DMS robustness mediation test.
The single most important open question is:
Is the standard code’s experimentally measured one-step mistranslation robustness fully mediated by  $e_{\rm in}$ , or does any residual robustness remain after conditioning on synonymous edge hiding?
